setting.sync.cloud_folder_change_warning: Choosing a folder pauses the task and waits for its current file operation to finish, then clears the old comparison history, conflicts, and unfinished operations. Cloud files may replace same-name local files in albums not selected for upload on the next sync. Cloud files are never deleted by this change.
